item.title: Jamie O’Brien Says This Is the ‘Biggest Crowd He’s Ever Seen at Pipeline’
item.description: For someone like Jamie O'Brien, the real danger lies in the other people at Pipe. And recently, there were a LOT of other people at the North Shore's gem.

item.title: California’s Sierra Nevada Could Get Over 5 Feet of Snow This Week
item.description: Forecasters are calling for a big uptick for the Sierra Nevada in the next few days. Most models are calling for up to 70 inches of snow thanks to this storm.

item.title: John West, ‘That Surf Guy,’ Is Connecting Image Makers With Everyday Surfers
item.description: John West, That Surf Guy, is a modern surfpreneur. His brand of surf comedy has resonated with his audience. And he's helping image makers extend their careers.

item.title: Can We Please Stop Claiming World Records Every Time a Surfer Catches a Giant Nazare Wave?
item.description: Big wave surfing's totally predictable trend of immediately marketing the latest bomb of the day as a "world record" or "first 100-foot wave" is...annoying.

item.title: Ben Gravy, Sunset Beach, and a Lesson in Respect and Humility
item.description: Sunset Beach is one of the world's most famous waves. Ben Gravy took it on during his Hawaiian sojourn, and it was everything he thought it would be.

item.title: The Surfing Santas Are Back in a Cocoa Beach Holiday Tradition
item.description: Cocoa Beach is known for two things in the world of surfing: Birthing Kelly Slater and a bunch of people riding waves while dressed up in Santa costumes.

item.title: Watch: Great Lakes Ice Beards (and Dreads) Are Back
item.description: When it comes to Great Lakes surfing, getting an ice beard or having frozen dreads is a badge of honor. Because Great Lakes surfers embrace the cold.

item.title: Ski Race Shut Down After Famous Bear Wanders On To Slope
item.description: A ski race in Alberta, Canada, had to be canceled due to the surprise arrival of a celebrity bear.

item.title: Australian Artist Collecting Lost Surfboard Fins Says Nearly Three-Quarters Are a Specific Brand
item.description: An Australian artist who has spent years collecting lost surfboard fins near Bells Beach says nearly three-quarters of those he’s found are a specific brand.

item.title: Telluride Ski Patrollers Vote to Go On Strike This Week
item.description: On Tuesday night, the Telluride Professional Ski Patrol Association voted to go on strike starting December 27.
